purpose: Reusable generalized legal-build integration architecture preserving CP94 sampling/mover-neutral design while separating movement-path closest approach from actual final post-Movement firing-window readiness, carrying explicit side-specific readiness metadata into runtime variants, and emitting a consolidated outlier review. It is not an evidence log and does not automatically promote gameplay values.

pairingPolicy.note: Candidate/control variants should share random streams whenever the changed dimension permits a clean paired comparison.

activationPolicy: Activate the smallest dependency-relevant submatrix that answers the causal question, then carry locally validated candidates into broader mixed-TL integration.
A shared sensitivity axis does not imply symmetric promotion across subsystem families.
Include mixed-TL, high-power-demand, and unusual-but-legal construction contexts when the changed dependency can interact with them.
Use actual-consumer preflight plus one-trial smoke before substantive Monte Carlo for any new or materially changed integrated study.
Audit dispatch, pre-run validation, shared/global gate classifications, study-specific gates, report routing, schema/baseline bindings, checkpoint stages, and study-family helpers before handoff.
Keep outcome/balance targets review-only unless a deterministic invariant is genuinely being promoted.
Construction legality follows actual Installation Space/prerequisite/compatibility rules; simultaneous Tactical Power insufficiency is an operational tradeoff, not an automatic invalid-build filter.
Generated broad-permutation studies must pass deterministic generator validation, actual-consumer preflight, and one-trial full-pipeline smoke before substantive screening.
Every legal combat build must include at least one Main Weapon and at least one Reactor; optional explicit duplication remains legal when actual construction constraints permit it.
Generated doctrine must price rated systems at their actual effective Tactical Power cost before optional activation decisions.

Dynamic movement/range doctrine must preserve attack eligibility. Broad legal-build fixed references may legitimately be track-denied or strategically weak, but zero-attack lanes caused overwhelmingly by self-inflicted Tactical Power starvation are release failures.

Generalized enumeration may include optional absence of non-core systems and explicit component duplication; never prune a legal build merely because it appears strategically weak or power-constrained.
Redundant same-type ECM/ECCM installations are physically distinct for damage/redundancy but resolve to the highest applicable functional rating rather than additive strength.
Bounded screens should stratify by progression distance and build composition so cross-TL cliffs and odd legal combinations are not hidden by named recipes alone.

Separate structural engagement readiness from observed runtime combat activity; readiness describes whether a build can legally engage under declared reference/closing geometry, not whether doctrine actually fired.

Matched broad screens should sample unordered distinct legal pairs and emit both A-vs-B and B-vs-A orientations where practical so side assignment is observable rather than silently confounded with progression.
Classify used-Space explicitly and report Space-pair strata/deltas so legitimate construction-envelope advantages are not mislabeled as technology advantages.

When stratification changes sample frequency, report legal population counts, inclusion fractions, and population-weighted screening estimates alongside raw sample summaries; weighting restores cell prevalence but does not make one sampled pair exhaustive of a cell.
Use side-specific family/context activity telemetry and release gates so a dead Kinetic, Energy, or Missile lane cannot be hidden by activity from the opposing side.
Do not collapse mixed-TL comparisons into a universal scalar technology score; report explicit progression magnitude/direction, Space, family, and information-control comparability dimensions.

When primary-cell population weights are concentrated, increase the number of statistical representatives in larger cells before merely increasing trials per representative; keep allocation deterministic, bounded, and explicit.

Separate inference samples from diagnostic diversity overlays. Only the inference/statistical sample receives population-representative weight; overlays and named anchors remain zero-weight review evidence.

A structurally mutual-ready zero-action pairing must be diagnosed individually. If TrackAware movement never reached the mutual ready range, report movement/doctrine denial; if ready geometry was reached and multi-trial activity remained zero, fail the integration/activity gate.
Retain both movement-order bounds and report mover-order-neutral matched estimates plus initiative sensitivity before selecting any production initiative rule.
Movement-path closest approach and post-Movement combat geometry are distinct telemetry. Never use path closest approach as proof that an ordinary post-Movement firing window was reached.

For structural-readiness activity diagnosis, carry side-specific readiness metadata into the runtime variant and record per-trial post-Movement ready-window reach; do not depend on profile-label parsing or mean minimum path range.

Outlier reporting should surface engagement/activity anomalies, path-versus-post-Movement geometry divergence, and mover-order sensitivity separately so review priority is explicit without turning diagnostic tails into automatic gameplay gates.

currentCoverage.currentExpansion: Replay the exact CP94 legal envelope, adaptive sample, diversity overlay, movement-order bounds, pair-selection seed, and combat seed while adding explicit runtime readiness metadata, post-Movement firing-window reach telemetry, corrected observed-engagement diagnosis, and a consolidated outlier review.
currentCoverage.combatActivityGuard: Judge structural-ready activity from per-trial final post-Movement firing-window reach. Movement-path closest approach remains separate diagnostic telemetry. Fixed structural-ready lanes must observe a ready firing window; dynamic lanes that never reach it remain movement diagnostics. Reached mutual geometry with no actions is blocking in substantive runs; one-side inactivity remains review evidence and side/family/context gates remain active.
currentCoverage.populationWeighting: Each primary cell population is divided equally among its adaptive statistical representatives; statistical forward weights recover the full 255,187,936 unordered-distinct population. Diversity and named diagnostics carry zero inference weight.
currentCoverage.moverOrderAnalysis: Preserve Side-A-first and Side-B-first bounds and derive a matched first/second neutral estimate plus low/moderate/high/extreme initiative-sensitivity labels.
currentCoverage.powerAwareDoctrine: Use preserve-combat-package EW doctrine with actual rating-scaled ECM/ECCM costs.
currentCoverage.crossTlDirection: Prove CP95 instrumentation fidelity and causal replay against accepted CP94 before using the standing suite for technology tuning.
